{{Quote|He swore fealty to Darth Nyriss a dozen years ago when she led an Imperial force into his sector to subdue a potential uprising.|Sechel, on Ugroth|<ref name="Revan" />}}
Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] faced a potential uprising in a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Ugroth's sector|sector]] under the rule of the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Ugroth]]. In response, the Empire '''dispatched''' an [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial force]] under the command of a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], [[Darth Nyriss]], with the objective of subduing the [[Unidentified anti-Imperial group|insurrection]]. Ugroth swore his allegiance to Nyriss at the [[Time/Legends|time]], and at some point after that, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] acquired a bust of the warlord. [[3954 BBY|Twelve years later]], the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] [[Sechel]] told the Sith Lord [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] of the subjugation.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The subjugation of Ugroth's sector was mentioned in the [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]].<ref name="Revan" />
